sentences.text: Pengornis belongs to the family Pengornithidae, a group of early birds.
The holotype specimen, the specific fossil the species is based on, holds the accession number IVPP V15336.
A second, juvenile specimen (IVPP V18632) was later described by Hu, Zhou, and O'Connor in 2014.
This animal lived during the Aptian stage, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
Its fossils were collected from the Jiufotang Formation at Dapingfang, Chaoyang, Liaoning, China.
